title: Addressable African markets
note: Note: Modelled addressable adult leisure and business trips a year; the estimate does not define addressable. The sources rank Ghana differently. Demand-Side Analysis, Jun 2026, p28.
deck_only_values: Eight ranges read from the bars on Demand-Side Analysis p28 against its 0 to 600 thousand axis (vector bar geometry of the PDF page; each edge falls within 0.1 thousand of the value given) and drawn without value labels: Zimbabwe 180,000 to 290,000; Botswana 105,000 to 175,000; Zambia 95,000 to 160,000; Mozambique 65,000 to 120,000; Tanzania 65,000 to 115,000; Uganda 30,000 to 60,000; Ethiopia 25,000 to 50,000; Rwanda 25,000 to 50,000.
The eight market names and the ranking by upper estimate (Nigeria, Kenya, Zimbabwe, Botswana, Zambia, Mozambique, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Ethiopia, Rwanda), p28.
Foot line wording 'Each bar spans the lower and upper estimate', p28.
conflicts: None. The p28 bars for Nigeria (310 to 510), Kenya (240 to 400) and Ghana (55 to 100) agree with v15.
lead_in: The modelled pools far exceed current visits in each of the three priority markets (Figure 2.12).
